deviations.what: t2 widens to make every role-enumerating surface decider-aware with minimal entries (cli/_commands/up.py ROLE_SERVICE decider -> decider service; gateway/_config.py decider as opt-in backend, infeasible by default; lobes measure _FAMILY_BY_ROLE 'decide' family; tests/test_embed_lanes.py ROLES pin; capabilities goldens regenerated); t3 additionally makes 'lobes switch' refuse task=decide gears (cli/_commands/switch.py) and keeps its regenerated tests/goldens/switch-plans.txt
deviations.reason: Adding 'decider' to ROLES broke 16 tests outside roles.py; the plan put role tables in t2 and every consumer in later waves, which cannot keep the suite green per merge (TDD gate), and lobes measure + the embed-lanes ROLES pin were owned by no task. t3's catalog entries made lobes switch render a vLLM plan for decide gears (2B shown at 8192 vs its 4096 window), covered by no task.

deviations.what: t5 also owns the gateway service's DECIDER_DOMAINS environment passthrough line in lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml (t8 owns every other template edit and must not touch the gateway env block); t2's d1 merge likewise added DECIDER_* gateway passthrough lines there
deviations.reason: The doctor/gateway passthrough guard tests fail whenever gateway/_config.py reads an env key the compose gateway block does not pass through, so the reader and its passthrough line must land in the same merge; pinned in both briefs to keep same-wave t5/t8 file-disjoint

deviations.what: Adopt Aikimi/clef-nf4 (bitsandbytes NF4, weight-only) as the served Clef build for the transformers sidecar stage instead of JRamirez-UAB/clef-GPTQ-W4A16 (kept for the t13 vLLM stage): t3 adds a catalog entry for it; t4's clef backend loads it through the repo's clef_runtime.Runner from a flat snapshot_download(local_dir=...) instead of Cloudflare's bf16 load_release_model; Dockerfile.decider pins transformers 5.10.2 / tokenizers<=0.23.0 / bitsandbytes 0.50.2 for the clef backend
deviations.reason: t1 spike (docs/evidence/2026-10-14-spike-clef-nf4-transformers-orin.txt): JRamirez's card says its transformers path is a dequantized bf16 copy (~54 GB, cannot load beside orin-embed); the NF4 build loaded at 15.4-16.3 GiB peak and answered; its bundle loader rejects symlinked HF-cache files and needs transformers 5.10.2 (Dockerfile.decider currently pins 5.19.0 for strands)

deviations.what: Clef serving is rebuilt on our OWN quantized checkpoints made from Cloudflare/clef@2f3de3dd (no third-party quant is served): a W4A16 build for the Jetson Orin (Ampere, Marlin) and an NVFP4 (W4A4) build for Blackwell (Spark/Thor), both uploaded to the culture-dev HF org (not jetson-ai-lab). Until the Orin build is served, decider:general runs Cloudflare's original bf16 weights with Cloudflare's own code in the decider sidecar on the Spark (interim 'healing'). A configured-but-down decider answers 503 + Retry-After. Supersedes proposed d3 (Aikimi NF4).
deviations.reason: User decisions 2026-10-14 after the t1 spike and the third-party-quant safety audit: third-party quants (Aikimi NF4, JRamirez GPTQ) are not to be trusted for serving; one flavour per hardware class (Orin = W4A16, Blackwell = NVFP4); upload target culture-dev; bf16 on the Spark as the interim backend

deviations.what: t20's NVFP4 build keeps EVERY linear_attn (GatedDeltaNet) projection bf16, not the Orin build's narrower keep-list (in_proj_a/b only): llm-compressor 0.14.0's own Qwen3.5 NVFP4 recipe documents the fused GDN projections as incompatible with NVFP4. Also: t19/t20 run on the Spark BEFORE the t17 interim (user decision 2026-10-14: 'Spark first, then interim'), since quantization and the bf16 interim cannot co-reside.
deviations.reason: upstream NVFP4 constraint on GatedDeltaNet; Spark memory (quant ~55 GB + interim ~56 GB > ~94 GB free)
